title: ctxpipe check result
description: One NDJSON line of `pnpm checks:run` output, for each requested check id.

status.description: error: the check did not run (unknown id, setup failure, load error).

origin.description: Optional. Set only on an error record of a check that did not run because of a fault outside the check: prerequisite (a prerequisite failed) or runner (the runner failed, or the check is unknown). Set by the runner only; a test file cannot set it. A consumer detects an infrastructure fault from this field, never from the message text.

log.description: Repo-relative path of the runner log for the group of checks.

usage.description: The model use of an eval run, for each model. It never holds prompt or answer text. Optional; only eval checks have it.

costUsd.description: The cost from the price list of the model provider. Absent when the price is not known.
